PurchaseVersions.title: PO versions
PurchaseVersions.body:
Every change to a live purchase order happens here as a new version, never by rewriting the old one. The list shows your orders; the detail carries the immutable version timeline with the reason behind each change.

The detail also holds the amendment workspace: adjust quantities and prices of the open lines, preview the effect on the committed value, then apply or submit for approval.

The amended document is rendered but never sent automatically.
